family: one word (news, macro, positioning, volume, calendar, crypto-flow, ...): never the family of the last ledger line
hypothesis: What predicts what, in one or two sentences.
mechanism: Why it should hold (who is forced to trade, who is late), and why it is not one of the closed families.

data.signal: source, URL pattern, exact field; the KNOWN-AT rule of every external value (e.g. FRED daily: observation date + 1 business day 13:00 UTC)
data.publication_lag: the declared min_lag of every external series (data.external / data.fred min_lag), and for FRED non-daily series: revised values used (revised_ok) or why not
data.prices: kit.data.load_bars(<fp key>) = Dukascopy H1 BID (Binance 1h for btcusd/ethusd), FP crypto weekend removed
data.in_sample_years: first year .. 2021 (>= 4 years); power check: n signals counted from the signal data alone = ...

rule_main.signal: exact formula, with the time each signal is known (a value from a bar's close is known at the bar's end)
rule_main.entry: open of the first H1 bar opening at or after known_at (+ delay_h)
rule_main.overlap: one position per market (kit.sim mode 'one'); every-signal variant for the every-signal bar

costs: kit.costs (lab/r2/fp_costs.json, FP Raw): gross, net, spread and slippage x1.5
bars: CHARTER.md 'The bars' on 01_main, computed by kit.judge.verdict (one market or basket; small-basket amendment applies); random-entry null 2000 draws; weekly corr with the ten <= 0.30; deflated Sharpe on N_all (N_main reported)
split: IS only (to 2021-12-31). VAL only per charter rule 5 (val_declared.json, then kit.data.unlock_val).
kit: lab/explore/kit (state the kit files' sha256 or the commit if you change the kit)
